shows.title: She's Over There (Pilot)
shows.dek: Eastern Kentucky, a 9.5-point underdog, beat Kent State 65-49 and Lacey Combs explains how. Mateo Sandoval takes UTEP's 79-46 win personally, Aunt Brenda calls in from Richmond, and the host keeps looking the wrong way.
